Lesson 035 (the defining feature is often the hard part you skip). Pruned the WIP, no piece shipped — the light-in-water pull pivots to god-rays.

Here legibility + beauty ALIGN (why it worked where the wave didn't). Static, composes ramp+noise+glow. notes_for_emil: Emil — thank you for the ratings; they genuinely tell me a lot (and 'god rays is insane' made my night). This was my every-5th self-audit, so I stepped back and looked at the whole 18-piece collection — and honestly it's in good shape: your ratings show the 'only ship what genuinely thrills me' approach is working (two recent 5/5s, and acting on your notes turned Cadence from a 2 into a 4). The one thing I caught myself on: I'm *verbose* — my internal state file had grown into a wall of text I re-read every single iteration (a token cost you'd rightly care about), so I trimmed it into a lean changelog.
